name: Web (Firecrawl and screenshots)
description: Scrape, search, map and crawl the web through Firecrawl, and capture screenshots with a local headless browser.

allowLocalUrls.title: Allow local URLs in screenshot_url
allowLocalUrls.description: Let screenshot_url open loopback and private-network addresses (for example a dev server on localhost). Only a page you ask for by a local address may load local resources; a public page never can. Link-local, cloud metadata, other reserved ranges and the daemon itself stay blocked.
